data.name: Extraction_AnchorsHint
data.value: Hold Ctrl and drag over stable text to add an anchor. Expand a value anchor, then drag to add fields. Expand a table anchor, then drag over the entire header row — columns are split automatically and dividers can be dragged (double-click to add/remove). Documents with unstable layout or changing header font sizes are out of scope.

data.name: About_Subtitle
data.value: Extract structured data from fixed-layout PDF documents.

data.name: About_Body
data.value: PlainBytes DocumentExtractor is a lightweight Windows utility for extracting structured data from fixed-layout PDF documents and exporting the results to Excel. No complex configuration is required. Define the fields you need, then extract data from multiple PDF files with simple actions.

data.name: About_CustomDev_Intro
data.value: Need a document or data processing tool tailored to your specific workflow? We also provide custom development for PDF and document processing, data extraction, spreadsheet/CSV processing, format conversion, batch processing, and related automation workflows.

data.name: About_CustomDev_Simple
data.value: Simple utilities — such as single-purpose extraction, conversion, or batch processing tools — can often be delivered quickly.

data.name: About_CustomDev_Custom
data.value: Custom applications — including tools with multiple features, a user interface, or integration with your existing workflow — can be developed based on your requirements.

data.name: About_CustomDev_Pricing
data.value: Pricing depends on the scope and complexity of your project. Tell us what you're trying to achieve, and we'll provide a quote.

data.name: About_CustomDev_Dialog_Lead
